semantics.function: q is 1 exactly when a and b are both 1; otherwise q is 0
semantics.timing: Combinational, no clock, state, or added latency
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior specified
semantics.initialization: At original time 0, a=0,b=0,q=0 after combinational settling; no unspecified state initialization required

verification.oracle: Explicit expected q values from original waveform, independent of RTL expression
verification.stimulus: Replay every original sample at 0,5,...,90 ns; drive changes at original timestamps and sample after delta settling
verification.coverage: All four binary combinations, repeated transitions and stable intervals
verification.failure: Case-inequality mismatch triggers $fatal; bounded timeout; PASS only after all checks

specification_ambiguities: Original waveform does not specify X/Z input behavior; use standard Verilog bitwise AND semantics without claiming this is required by the binary waveform.
